name: users_notifications
problem: Notifications must target users, respect their channel preferences, and honor unsubscribe.
glue: notification_center resolves recipient users, checks per-user channel prefs + unsubscribe state, then dispatches via comms_core (email/push/sms).
steps: Add notification_preferences to the users model (or a side table).
notification_center filters recipients by prefs and unsubscribe_handling state.
Dispatch through email/sms/push parts; record delivery.
